settings.title: Customer Support
settings.body: Our customer support team is available to answer questions about your orders, products, and account. Reach us at supports@linecommercial.com and we will respond as quickly as possible within our business hours.

settings.title: Support Hours
settings.body: Our support team is available Monday through Friday, from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Messages received outside these hours will be answered on the next business day.

settings.title: Order and Shipping Inquiries
settings.body: For questions about an existing order, tracking information, or shipping times, please have your order number ready and contact us at supports@linecommercial.com.

settings.title: Returns and Refunds Assistance
settings.body: If you need to start a return, exchange, or refund, please review our Return & Refund Policy or contact our support team directly for assistance.

settings.title: Wholesale and Business Inquiries
settings.body: Interested in partnering with LINE or purchasing in bulk? Send us the details of your business and we will get back to you with more information.

settings.title: Press and Media
settings.body: For press inquiries, media kits, or collaboration proposals, please reach out to our team and include the details of your request.

settings.title: Careers
settings.body: We are always open to meeting talented people. If you are interested in joining our team, feel free to send us your information and area of interest.

settings.title: Social Media
settings.body: Follow us and reach out through our social media channels for quick updates, promotions, and another way to get in touch with our team.

settings.title: Response Times
settings.body: We aim to respond to all inquiries within 24 to 48 business hours. During high-demand periods, response times may be slightly longer.
